scope: AGENTINPUT1 orthotropic material-status locale round trip

historicalBrowserReproduction.meaning: Root observed three fallback guides translated to Japanese while their material-status focus destination retained English.

cause.ja: 英語で生成した動的文をスキャナーが翻訳元として記憶し、日本語への復帰時も英語を保持した。全文辞書も不足していた。
cause.en: An English-generated dynamic sentence became the scanner source, so returning to Japanese retained English. The full-sentence dictionary entry was also missing.

fix.ja: 直交異方性の説明を他の状態文と同じ日本語の翻訳元へ統一し、全文の英訳を辞書へ追加。言語変更時のフォーム再描画は追加しない。
fix.en: Emit the canonical Japanese source like the other status messages and register its complete English translation. No language-change form redraw is added.

green.command: node --test tests/ui-material-form-scanner.test.mjs tests/ui-material-form.test.mjs tests/i18n.test.mjs tests/ui-agent-connection-status-scanner.test.mjs tests/ui-spherical-region-scanner.test.mjs tests/ui-analysis-preflight.test.mjs tests/docs.test.mjs

coverage: actual src/i18n.js scanner using mini DOM and mutation delivery
JA initial load -> EN and dynamic replacement while EN -> JA -> EN
draft notes/density/dependence, text selection and status focus preserved
all three real preflight fallback buttons focus translated status and preserve drafts
limits: This fix evidence uses a mini DOM, not a real browser. Root owns the subsequent real IAB confirmation.
Language change retains existing preflight report invalidation; tests explicitly run preflight again for each locale.
